cards.title: Calculate ROI from profit and cost of goods
cards.claim: The speaker defines ROI as profit divided by cost of goods, multiplied by 100, and uses a minimum 30% ROI as a product check, with a stated exception for products selling “really well.”

do_not_use_when: The product is selling “really well, like 2,000 times,” where the speaker says they may accept 20% ROI
unknowns: Whether the 30% threshold accounts for all costs in every situation
